changes.description: Federal bank regulatory agencies issued an interim final rule to neutralize regulatory capital effects for banks participating in the Federal Reserve's Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) facility, applying a zero percent risk weight to these loans.
changes.evidence_quote: The interim final rule modifies the agencies' capital rules to neutralize the regulatory capital effects of participating in the Federal Reserve's PPP facility... the interim final rule also clarifies that a zero percent risk weight applies to loans covered by the PPP for capital purposes.
